title: 3 signs someone secretly dislikes you (#1 will surprise you)
hook: Three signs someone secretly dislikes you. Number one is the one nobody expects.

items.name: Short answers
items.line: They answer, but never ask anything back. Psychologists call this low reciprocity, and it's rarely an accident.
items.image_prompt: two people at a cafe table, one texting and looking away, other person talking, cinematic moody lighting

items.name: No small talk
items.line: They skip small talk with you but not with others. Small talk is a social investment. They're not investing.
items.image_prompt: group of coworkers chatting in an office kitchen while one person stands slightly apart, cinematic lighting

items.name: Too polite
items.line: They are extra polite. Studies link over-politeness to social distance. Warmth is casual. Dislike is formal.
items.image_prompt: a person giving a stiff, overly formal smile and handshake, dramatic close-up, cinematic

outro: Who did you just think of? Be honest.
description: Three subtle signs that someone doesn't like you, from low reciprocity to over-politeness. Not medical advice, just psychology.
visual_prompt: two people in an awkward conversation, subtle tension, cinematic moody lighting, dark teal and amber palette
